title: Reconnecting no longer reloads the page
outcome: SerwistProvider stops calling location.reload() on the browser's online event, so regaining connection mid-match no longer discards the set in progress, the rally being edited, or scroll position. Reconnect refresh keeps happening through SWR's existing per-request revalidation instead.
acceptanceCriteria: SerwistProvider in src/app/layout.tsx passes reloadOnOnline={false}, so its online-event listener is never registered.
No other behaviour of SerwistProvider changes: service worker registration stays disabled outside production, and swUrl is untouched.
SWRConfig in src/components/layout/swr-provider.tsx is unmodified, so revalidateOnReconnect keeps SWR's default of true and every hook still refetches on reconnect.
